research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Shinkei Systems is researching systems and methods for automated fish processing, focusing on a method for processing a live fish that determines fish attributes, optionally sorts them, and performs euthanizing and exsanguinating. They develop systems for fish processing that integrate a fish fixturing subsystem, tooling subsystem, analysis subsystem, and intake subsystem. Together, these systems and methods enable automated handling, analysis, and humane processing of fish.
